summary: First end-to-end smoke test of FACTIONOPS Torn faction tracker. Backend endpoints (/, /settings GET+POST, /live, /history, /history/seed, DELETE /history) all respond correctly with mock data. API key masking works (abc***45 format). Frontend dashboard loads with 20 members per faction, header stats, countdown, source badge, timeline chart with 5 range buttons, settings sheet persists faction names, and manual refresh. One backend spec violation found: POST /settings with api_key="" (empty string) overwrites existing stored key instead of preserving it.
passed: GET /api/settings returns defaults with empty api_key
POST /api/settings updates faction names and ids
POST /api/settings with real api_key stores it; GET returns masked form (abc***45)
GET /api/live returns source=='mock', mine+enemy each with 20 members, online+idle+offline==20, all required member fields present
GET /api/history?hours=12 returns sorted HistoryPoint list with all required fields
Header shows FACTIONOPS, poll-countdown decrementing (28s->26s), source-badge='MOCK SIMULATION'
stat-mine-active, stat-enemy-active, stat-advantage, stat-window all render numeric values
faction-panel-mine and faction-panel-enemy each render 20 member-row entries
timeline-chart renders; all 5 range buttons (1h/6h/24h/72h/168h) exist and clickable
Settings sheet opens; inputs accept values; save-settings-button persists faction names (RedTeamX & BlueTeamY appear in panel headers)
reseed-button triggers reseed; refresh-button resets countdown to 29s

failed.issue: Sending api_key="" (empty string) overwrites the stored api_key rather than preserving the existing value. Spec says: 'when api_key is empty or omitted, it must preserve existing key'. Omitted works (exclude_none skips it), but explicit empty string wipes the key.
failed.evidence: Set api_key='abcdef12345' -> GET returns 'abc***45'. Then POST {"api_key":""} -> GET returns api_key=''. Code path: server.py lines 304-308 — the guard only skips when value contains '***', not when it's empty.

action_items: In /app/backend/server.py update_settings loop (lines ~304-308): also skip overwriting when k=='api_key' and v=='' (empty string) to honor the preserve-existing-key spec.
